name: Index YouTube Playlist

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at midnight UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      playlist_id:
        description: 'YouTube Playlist ID to index (optional, uses default if not provided)'
        required: false
        default: ''
      force_reindex:
        description: 'Force reindexing of all videos (ignores cache)'
        required: false
        default: 'false'

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write # Required for OIDC authentication with Cloudflare

jobs:
  index-youtube:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Cloudflare Wrangler
        run: npm install -g wrangler

      - name: Authenticate with Cloudflare
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}

      - name: Index YouTube Playlist
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_API_KEY }}
          YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_ID: ${{ github.event.inputs.playlist_id || secrets.YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_ID }}
          VECTORIZE_INDEX_NAME: ${{ secrets.VECTORIZE_INDEX_NAME }}
          R2_BUCKET_NAME: ${{ secrets.R2_BUCKET_NAME }}
          FORCE_REINDEX: ${{ github.event.inputs.force_reindex || 'false' }}
        run: |
          # Run the specific YouTube indexing script
          # Assuming the script is located at scripts/index-youtube-playlist.ts or similar
          # Adjust the path below to match your actual project structure
          npx tsx scripts/index-youtube-playlist.ts

      - name: Notify on Failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "YouTube indexing job failed. Check logs for details."
          # Optional: Add Slack/Discord notification webhook call here
